units.source_text: 与其成为白色幽灵世界的居民，不如死后变成一只白鸽，或一株白莲花。

en.t: Rather than become a resident of a white ghostly world, it would be better after death to turn into a white dove, or a white lotus.

units.source_text: 抱着这种想法活着，心中的爱是多么博大和坦荡呀。

en.t: To live while holding such a thought, how vast and open the love in one's heart must be.
